name: Candidate Falcon
tagline: Most candidates don’t fail hiring assessments because they lack ability
description: Most candidates don’t fail hiring assessments because they lack ability. They fail because they’ve never seen the format before. That’s the gap Candidate Falcon is built to solve. Modern hiring processes rely heavily on formats like game-based assessments and one-way video interviews. These aren’t traditional interviews.
